candidates.name: OS Terrain 5 Technical Specification
verified_facts: OS Terrain 5 grid uses regular 5 m post spacing.
Supply is in 5 km by 5 km tiles identified by National Grid reference of the south-west corner.
GML geometries use EPSG:27700.
semantic_limits: Terrain 5 remains secondary sanity evidence and does not replace EA 1 m DTM primary sampling.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 5 current product documentation
verified_facts: OS Terrain 5 is a bare-earth DTM with buildings and trees removed.
The product is updated quarterly in January, April, July and October.
Grid and contour products are supplied as 5 km tiles.
semantic_limits: Release cadence is freshness evidence only and does not imply a parcel elevation changed each quarter.

candidates.name: National Grid Transformation OSTN15
verified_facts: OSTN15 is the definitive OSGB36/ETRS89 transformation.
It uses a 1 km shift grid and bilinear interpolation.
Simple Helmert transformation is limited to about 3 m accuracy applications.
semantic_limits: OSTN15 is horizontal transformation evidence and must not be used to reduce vertical LiDAR RMSE.

candidates.name: Future of British mapping coordinate systems
verified_facts: OSGB36 and ODN remain the basis of OS mapping for the foreseeable future.
OSTN15 and OSGM15 provide ETRS89 to OSGB36 and ODN access.
semantic_limits: National datum continuity does not prove source-surface accuracy at an individual parcel.

candidates.name: OS NGD coordinate reference systems
verified_facts: Many OS land features use British National Grid EPSG:27700.
Collections carrying ODN heights may use British National Grid plus ODN Height EPSG:7405.
semantic_limits: Compound CRS evidence is a schema/reference QA gate and not a new elevation measurement.

candidates.name: Standards and CRS - OS MasterMap Water Network
verified_facts: British National Grid EPSG:27700 is a horizontal spatial reference system and does not specify a vertical reference system.
ODN is the common mainland Britain orthometric height datum.
EPSG:7405 combines British National Grid with ODN Height.
semantic_limits: This product is not a terrain source; it is retained only as authoritative CRS semantics evidence.

candidates.name: Ordnance Survey coordinate systems
verified_facts: OS Net uses ETRS89.
The National Grid combines OSGB36 with a Transverse Mercator projection for easting and northing coordinates.
semantic_limits: Coordinate-system definitions are transformation QA, not terrain-height observations.

candidates.name: National Grid and the OSGB36 TRF
verified_facts: OSGB36 is the traditional reference frame underlying National Grid mapping.
National Grid eastings and northings use the Transverse Mercator projection.
semantic_limits: Reference-frame semantics do not replace OSTN15 when transforming modern ETRS89 positions.

candidates.name: Survey Data Catalogue point density guidance
verified_facts: A 1 m DSM survey has average point density of at least 1 point per square metre.
DTM point density under vegetation may be lower than DSM density.
Point cloud density is not the same concept as raster resolution.
semantic_limits: Point density must not be converted directly into parcel confidence or raster sample count.

candidates.name: Survey Data Catalogue ASCII to GeoTIFF guidance
verified_facts: EA composite 1 m and 2 m elevation products moved from ASCII to GeoTIFF.
GeoTIFF files are supplied in 5 km tiles with elevations in metres.
GeoTIFF enables web services such as WCS.
semantic_limits: File-format migration must not alter elevation semantics or be treated as an accuracy improvement by itself.

candidates.name: Survey Data Catalogue coverage guidance
verified_facts: EA directs users to its index catalogue to determine product coverage by grid square.
semantic_limits: Absence from the catalogue must fail closed rather than be interpreted as zero elevation or flat terrain.

candidates.name: LiDAR Composite GeoPackage spatial metadata index guidance
verified_facts: LiDAR Composite downloads include a spatial metadata index in GeoPackage format.
The index describes spatial location and temporal extent of raster elevation data.
semantic_limits: Metadata index evidence supports lineage/freshness checks and is not itself a terrain-height source.
